title: The Integrity of Joseph: Surviving the Three Pressures
summary: Following an uplifting mission president seminar via Zoom featuring President Dallin H. Oaks, Elder D. Todd Christofferson, and Elder Carl B. Cook, President Hughes explores the life of Joseph of Egypt. He highlights how Joseph maintained a stellar work ethic and positive attitude as a slave and a prisoner, refusing to whine. Specifically, he analyzes the three major pressures Joseph resisted to preserve his integrity: the pull of the world, the power of physical attraction, and the peril of loneliness, demonstrating that God stands by those who remain faithful through unfair trials.
